takeaways: Azure IoT Hub manages the relationship with a device or edge gateway: per-device identity, enable and disable control, device twins and cloud-to-device requests.
Azure Event Hubs moves high-volume streams to many independent consumers through partitions, consumer groups, checkpoints and a limited retention window.
Many factory architectures need both: a managed gateway connects through IoT Hub while governed telemetry flows on to Event Hubs consumers such as OEE, storage and condition monitoring.
hook: Many manufacturers pick IoT Hub or Event Hubs because the name sounded right in the first workshop, then find out the data path cannot support how the plant runs. This episode is for OT, cloud and data architects who connect factory telemetry to Azure. You will learn when you need a device identity gate, when you need a data highway, and how to combine both without hidden costs.
